row:
Co-Owner & Director of Laser Me Out, one of the UK's fastest-growing laser hair removal brands.

Was working a 9-to-5 as a Physiotherapist. Built a personal brand through health, fitness, and lifestyle content on the side. Got the opportunity to start a business and reinvested everything into building Laser Me Out from the ground up.

Scaled it from a single treatment room to flagship clinics in London and Birmingham. Just getting started.

Mission: Show people that you don't need to be the smartest, richest, or best-connected to start a business. 
You just need to start.

Building in → London.
